findings.title: Amount claimed differs from total bills
findings.detail: The claim form amount claimed (33182.75) does not match the sum of the hospital bill total (32367.75) and the pharmacy bill (815.00), which equals 33182.75.

findings.title: Pharmacy bill location and date context differs
findings.detail: The pharmacy invoice is from Noida while the hospital is in Bengaluru, and the pharmacy bill date matches discharge but was issued outside the hospital context.
